record.question: In which city was India’s first digital population clock inaugurated in November, 2024?
record.explanation: Answer D: Bengaluru. ISEC reports inaugurating its digital population clock at its Bengaluru campus on8November2024. Bengaluru is the matching city. ISEC calls it the first of its kind in the region; that source does not prove the question’s stronger first-ever-in-India claim. Reference: https://www.isec.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Vol-31-2_July-December-2024_Final.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
